messages.content: That was phrased poorly, but the customer has said the meter for flat 1 is your MSN - 22L4065519, which we need to confirm. However, around 10 or so years ago, all the meters at this property were removed and the building was derelict, then in 2022,  British Gas installed new meters. I believe you are the supplier for this customer and they are under the old MPAN/meter with us. As the MPAN/MSN we have for our MPAN dates back to 1996 or 2009, which predates the meters being pulled out etc and your MPAN is the new one from 2022.  I have just picked this case up and have taken on plotting out the 30 flats associated with 24/26 Whalley Road which are a block of 30 flats divided into 24 and 26 address wise, but are all 30 meters are in one big building.

Good afternoon, I wanted to check what address, customer initials and MSN you hold for 1650000183422 in your system? We have 1610000159949 under FLAT 1, 26 WHALLEY ROAD, MANCHESTER, M16 8AB with customer initials T.B and F07N23940 for the MSN. The customer has sent pictures of the MSN 22L4065519, which is your MSN in ECOES. I believe that they have an account registered with us, but that you are actually their supplier.
